title: Hotel rate parity
description: Two row types share one dataset: parity (one property and stay with every booking source side by side and the parity math; charged) and status (one per property and stay: resolved, filtered, no rates, error; never charged).

dataset.title: Rate parity rows
dataset.description: Parity rows and status rows. Charged rows are billed as delivered; status rows are always free.

summary.title: Run summary
summary.description: One JSON record with the counts this run delivered and charged, how many properties undercut their official site, how many were filtered, not found or failed, and the HTTP stats.
